summary.zh: 更换或换绑密钥后，各 Agent 的配置会自动用上新密钥，不再需要手动重新切换站点。
summary.en: After changing or rebinding a key, agent configs pick up the new key automatically — no manual site re-switching needed.

highlights.zh: 在密钥管理里修改某个密钥的值后，所有用到它的 Agent 配置自动同步更新。
highlights.en: Editing a key's value in the vault now automatically updates every agent config that uses it.

highlights.zh: 站点换绑其他密钥（或修改接口地址）后，相关 Agent 配置同样自动更新。
highlights.en: Rebinding a site to a different key (or changing its endpoint) also refreshes the affected agent configs automatically.

highlights.zh: 命令行执行 modelswap vault set 保存密钥后，会提示已同步更新了几个 Agent 配置。
highlights.en: The modelswap vault set command now reports how many agent configs were updated with the new key.
